SpecialTraits.Spellcasting:
The Ashen Warpriest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared:

Cantrips (at will): Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy
1st level (4 slots): Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Shield of Faith
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon
3rd level (2 slots): Mass Healing Word, Spirit Guardians
SpecialTraits.War Priest: When the Ashen Warpriest takes the Attack action on its turn, it can make one Mace attack as a bonus action.
SpecialTraits.Ash Step: The Ashen Warpriest can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

Actions.Multiattack: The Ashen Warpriest makes two Mace attacks.
Actions.Mace: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.
Actions.Light Crossbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

Notes: Authored test fixture (not from a published book). Built to exercise: leveled bonus-action spells (Healing Word, Spiritual Weapon, Shield of Faith, Mass Healing Word) alongside leveled action spells (one leveled spell per turn); a bonus attack that depends on taking the Attack action (War Priest); a trait-granted bonus action (Ash Step); concentration (Shield of Faith, Hold Person, Spirit Guardians); spell slots per level; and a ranged attack with normal/long range.
